topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I find myself pacing the small confines of our living room, the weight of his betrayal pressing down on me. His words, his so-called art, laid bare in pages that now lie crumpled at my feet. How could he? Every detail, every secret, our most intimate moments-turned-fiction, exposed. I never asked for an audience to our life, yet here it is, a narrative he claims as his own. Did he even think of how this would affect me, us? I grab my coat, slam the door behind me, needing to escape the echo of his sculpted lies.
